sloka: अपि ते मुनि शार्दूल मम माता यशस्विनी ।दर्शिता राज पुत्राय तपो दीर्घम् उपागता ॥१-५१-४॥
transliteration: api te muni śārdūla mama mātā yaśasvinī ।darśitā rāja putrāya tapo dīrgham upāgatā ॥1-51-4॥

translations.english: "O Tiger among ascetics, was my renowned mother who had been practising intense austerities for long shown to the prince (Rama)?
